info.name: EverDigitech Admin API
info.description: Admin API (Laravel + Sanctum SPA cookies). Run 'Auth > 1. Get CSRF cookie', then 'Auth > 2. Login'. Import the environment file too. See docs/API.md.

exec: // Sanctum SPA auth: the API only starts a session for requests that come from a "stateful" origin,
// and it wants the XSRF cookie echoed back in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on every write.
// Token comes from the cookie jar, or from the copy saved by "1. Get CSRF cookie".
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'X-XSRF-TOKEN', value: fromCookie ? decodeURIComponent(raw) : raw });
console.warn('NO XSRF TOKEN. Run "Auth > 1. Get CSRF cookie" first, then send this request again.');

request.description: Sets the XSRF-TOKEN and session cookies. Run once before Login, and again if you ever get a 419.

exec: // Keep a copy of the token (URL-decoded) in case the cookie jar can't be read by later requests.
pm.test('XSRF-TOKEN cookie was sent', () => pm.expect(xsrf, 'no XSRF-TOKEN in Set-Cookie').to.not.equal(undefined));

request.description: Errors: 422 invalid_credentials, 429 account_locked (5 failures = 15 minute lock), 403 account_suspended.
Signs out the admin guard only. The session itself is kept.
Always the same answer. The email is written to storage/logs/laravel.log (MAIL_MAILER=log). Copy the token from the link.

item.name: Reset password / set password from invite

request.description: Min 12 characters, mixed case, a number, and not in a known data breach. Works for reset links (60 min) and staff invites (48 h).
A new role starts with no permissions. Saves its id as {{roleId}}.
reports.export automatically brings reports.view. Giving staff.* or roles.* needs a Super Admin. The Super Admin role answers 403 role_locked.
422 role_in_use while staff still have the role.

item.name: Try to edit the locked Super Admin role (403 role_locked)

request.description: Tick the disabled query params to filter: status (active|invited|suspended), role (a role id), search. 15 per page. meta.counts follows role and search; meta.stats is everyone.

exec: pm.test('has tab counts and card stats', () => { const m = pm.response.json().meta; pm.expect(m.counts).to.have.keys('all', 'active', 'invited', 'suspended'); pm.expect(m.stats).to.have.property('activeSuperAdmins'); });

item.name: Role options for the staff form

request.description: Needs only staff.view. Returns id, name, description and isSuperAdmin for every role.
No password. Open storage/logs/laravel.log for the 'Set your password' link, then call Reset password with that token. Saves the id as {{staffId}}.
Changing the role or suspending ends that person's sessions at once.
422 already_active if the person has signed in.

Needs clients.view. Tick the disabled params to filter: status (active|inactive|closed|all), group (regular|reseller|vip|all), search (name, company or owner email), sort (name, joined, balance, services, domains; prefix - for descending; default -joined). 15 per page; a page past the end returns the last page. meta.counts ignores the status filter (for the tabs) but follows group and search. Run 'php artisan migrate:fresh --seed' in the local environment to get 60 demo clients.

item.name: Log in as client (saves the token)

request.description: Needs clients.login_as (Super Admin, Admin). Optional body {"client_user_id": 12} for a member instead of the owner. Saves the one-time token (60 seconds) in impersonationToken: now run "Log in as client > Consume impersonation token" in the CLIENT collection. 422 account_closed for a closed account. Set accountId first (a client account id from List clients).

exec: pm.test('url points to the client panel', () => pm.expect(url).to.include('/impersonate?token='));

request.description: Needs clients.view. Owner, team, stats, recent tickets, domains and sign-ins.
Needs clients.edit. Only the fields sent change. group: regular, reseller, vip. status: active, inactive, closed.

item.name: Live feed (what is new since the cursor)

request.description: Run it once with an empty feedCursor (remove the after parameter) to get the starting cursor, then again after a client opens a ticket: the event appears. The admin panel does this every 20 seconds.

exec: const d = (pm.response.json() || {}).data || {}; if (d.cursor !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('feedCursor', String(d.cursor));

request.description: Filters: status, priority, department, assigned (me, unassigned, a staff id), search, sort (newest, oldest). Saves the first ticket id in adminTicketId.

item.name: One ticket (the thread, with staff notes)

request.description: Any file of the thread, staff notes included. Set attachmentId from the thread (replies[].attachments[].id), then use Send and Download.
The ticket becomes answered and the client gets a queued email (run the queue worker). Needs tickets.edit.
Nobody is told and the status stays.
Any of status (open, answered, closed), priority (low, medium, high), departmentId.
Send a staff id to assign, null to take it back. Needs tickets.assign.
All departments, switched off ones too. Saves the first id in departmentId.
Needs tickets.edit. The name must be unique.
422 last_active_department when it is the last one that is on.
Send EVERY department id once, in the new order (use the ids from the list).
Needs tickets.delete. 422 department_in_use when tickets use it.
Needs tickets.edit. Saves the first id in cannedReplyId.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Clear your cache",
  "body": "Hello {client_name},

Please clear your browser cache and try again.

Regards,
{staff_name}"
}

request.description: The words {client_name}, {ticket_number} and {staff_name} are filled in when the reply is inserted in the admin panel.
Needs products.view. All groups, hidden ones too. Saves the first id in productGroupId.
Needs products.create. type: hosting, server, domain, sms, software, service. The slug is made from the name.
Needs products.edit. A rename keeps the slug.
Needs products.delete. 422 group_in_use when the group has products.
What the product form needs: groups, billing cycles, types, currency and the tax setting.
Filters: group (id), status (all, active, inactive), search. meta.counts follows every filter except status. Saves the first id in productId.

All money is a whole number of PAISA (100 paisa = 1 taka): 89900 is 899 taka. Needs products.create. A product that is on needs at least one price. Each cycle can have one price: monthly, quarterly, semiannually, annually, biennially, triennially, one_time.
Needs products.edit. Send only what changes. When `prices` is sent it REPLACES the prices: cycles left out are removed.
Needs products.delete. It leaves the catalog but stays in the database (old orders point at it).
Needs settings.view. Until saved, the defaults from .env.
Needs settings.edit. rate is a percent (0-100, up to 2 decimals). inclusive=true: catalog prices already contain the tax. Prices are not changed; only the tax worked out from them.
All extensions, switched off ones too. Needs domains.view. Params: page, status (on|off|no_price|popular), search. 50 per page; meta.counts has the tab counts.

Needs domains.edit. Fetches Dynadot's whole price list. New extensions are added switched off; existing ones only get their cost, usage and restrictions refreshed (prices and on/off you set are kept). Returns {added, updated, total}.
Needs domains.edit. Switches on every extension that has a price (typed or worked out) and no registration restriction. Returns {activated}.
Needs domains.view. usdRate is null until it is set.
Needs domains.edit. Price = Dynadot cost x usdRate x (1 + marginPercent/100), rounded UP to a multiple of roundTo taka. A price typed on an extension wins.
Needs domains.edit. Prices are paisa (150000 = 1,500 taka); leave one out for "Ask for price".
Only the fields sent change. A price sent as null is cleared.
Needs domains.delete.
status: all, active, pending, expired, cancelled, expiring (active, ends within 30 days). Also search=.
Needs domains.create. A domain bought somewhere else, or by hand, that an account owns.
Needs domains.edit. Only the fields sent change.
Needs domains.delete. Removes it from the list; it is not cancelled at the registrar.
